name: zapier
description: Connect to 9000+ apps and 30000+ actions through the Zapier MCP server — send Slack messages, create Sheets rows, manage Jira/Asana tasks, update HubSpot deals, post Discord messages, and more, all through natural language.

interface.shortDescription: Connect to 9000+ apps through the Zapier MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Zapier skill connects the agent to Zapier's ecosystem of 9000+ apps and 30000+ actions through the Zapier MCP server. Each tool in the server corresponds to a Zapier action configured at mcp.zapier.com — pick the app, connect your account, and the agent can call it directly. No custom API integration code is needed. Supports all major apps: Slack, Gmail, Google Sheets, Jira, Asana, HubSpot, Discord, GitHub, Linear, Notion, and thousands more. The actual available tools depend on what the user configured.
defaultPrompt: Use Zapier when the user wants to interact with any of the 9000+ integrated apps without writing custom API code.
Ask what tools the user has configured in their Zapier MCP server before attempting to call any action.
Chain multiple Zapier actions when the task involves a sequence of operations across different apps.
Handle permission errors gracefully — suggest re-authenticating the connected app at mcp.zapier.com.
